name: Classic Smash Burger
description: Juicy smashed beef patty, aged cheddar, heirloom tomato, crisp bibb lettuce, and secret house spread on brioche bun.

name: Crispy Chicken Burger
description: Golden buttermilk-fried chicken breast, creamy jalapeño slaw, spicy pickles and chipotle mayo on a toasted bun.

name: BBQ Bacon Double Stack
description: Double smash patties layered with smoky bacon, caramelised onions, gouda cheese and bold BBQ sauce.

name: Pepperoni Paradise
description: Artisanal thin crust, signature marinara, fresh whole-milk mozzarella and crispy cupped pepperoni baked to perfection.

name: Margherita Classica
description: Vine-ripened tomatoes, handmade mozzarella curls, sweet basil leaves and extra virgin olive oil. Simple perfection.

name: BBQ Chicken Ranch
description: Smoky BBQ base, grilled chicken, red onions, jalapeños, mozzarella and a ranch drizzle on a golden crust.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Rich, velvet fettuccine tossed in parmesan-garlic cream sauce, finished with fresh cracked pepper and herbs.

name: Creamy Pesto Penne
description: Penne dressed in vibrant sweet basil pesto, baby spinach, roasted pine nuts and shaved pecorino romano.

name: Spicy Arrabbiata
description: Fiery red pepper flakes, slow-cooked San Marzano tomatoes and garlic tossed with fresh al dente rigatoni.
